name: True Lover's Knot
source: Set sail on the romantic adventure of the season! “True Lover’s Knot” follows the story of Emma, a London-based tech genius, as she and her best friend, Lucas, take to the high seas in a luxurious cruise that will change their lives forever!
translation: 扬帆起航，踏上本季最浪漫的冒险！《True Lover's Knot》讲述了常住伦敦的科技天才艾玛与好友卢卡斯登上豪华邮轮的故事。这趟远洋之旅将永远改变他们的人生！
